about: One-line summaries for docs/changelog.html (scripts/docs_changelog.py), by page. 'commits' maps a commit (its first 9 characters) to a summary that replaces the commit's subject; 'earlier' lists the revisions made before the page had a stable name, newest first.

First revision: the sphere-packed pad model of the printed fingertip.
